messages:
Priya: Quick sync  I filed quota request Q-20001 for us-central1 (mix of H100 + L40) to run an A/B canary for the new batching optimizer. VendorOps has a tentative staging window. Can we target Wed 07:30 CT for canary cutover if racks arrive on time? tagging @Carmen for provisional budget ok.

Kevin: Can you paste the request payload so I can update infra/quotas.yml and prepare the TF change? Also need to know if any new service account or firewall rules required.

Priya: Payload below, and I ran a quick region check.
```
project: redwood-prod
region: us-central1
quota_metric: NVIDIA_H100_GPUS
requested: 24
additional_metric: NVIDIA_L40_GPUS: 32
ticket: Q-20001
notes: canary-only, 48h retention
```
`gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=redwood-prod --format='json(quotas)' | jq '.[] | select(.metric=="NVIDIA_H100_GPUS" or .metric=="NVIDIA_L40_GPUS")'` showed current H100=0, L40=8.

InfraBot: Quota Q-20001 has been created in the vendor portal  status=pending_vendor_ack. Reminder: attach PR link to ticket when ready.

VendorOps: Tracking Q-20001. Tentative manifest: 2 racks H100 (12 GPUs/rack config), 2 racks L40 (16 GPUs/rack). Staging ETA Wed 04:30 CT, install complete by 06:30 CT if networking cleared. We need a confirmed rack access window 04:00-07:00 CT and host team's contact for network handoff.

Luca: If install finishes by 06:30 CT, we need these infra changes pre-applied: add reserved_pool=28 in `infra/pools.tf`, and allow CIDR 10.45.120.0/24 on the canary subnet (Ill add the firewall rule). Draft snippet: 
```
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "ab-canary-us-central1" {
  region = "us-central1"
  reserved_capacity = 28
  canary_tag = "batch-opt-v2"
}
```
Will double-check host targets.

Carmen: Budget note  preliminary cost estimate for that mix is ~$6.8k/month if kept as reserved; for a 48h canary the pro-rated is ~ $450. We can approve up to $7k/month temporary spend from the NRE/burst fund. Please file DA ticket with SKU breakdown.

FinanceBot: Provisional approval logged: DA-4522 created; linked to Q-20001. Please update final SKUs and duration.

Priya: Great. @VendorOps please cc manifest/tracking when final. @Kevin Ill need the TF PR by EOD tomorrow so infra can be applied before staging. I plan to start the canary smoke at ~07:45 CT and cut traffic at 07:30 only if smoke passes. :thumbsup: 

Kevin: I'll carve a small PR to `infra/quotas.yml` and `infra/pools.tf` tonight and ping here once it's ready for review. Will include firewall rule change and a short runbook step for on-call.

VendorOps: Will confirm manifest and tracking by EOD PST. Noted rack access window; please provide on-site contact.

Priya: Leaving this thread for async updates. If anyone sees a problem with the timing/hosts please shout here. /cc @Luca @Carmen
